articles.title: Tiny Snakes Roll Four Times Faster Than They Slither
articles.summary: Tiny dwarf reedsnakes roll about four times faster than they slither, keeping their heads steady while the rest of the body spins in a carefully timed pattern.

articles.title: This 150-Million-Year-Old Bird Had Dinosaur Teeth and a Strange Secret
articles.summary: A 150-million-year-old fossil from China mixes bird and dinosaur features and may be the earliest known bird lineage to lose flight.

articles.title: Astronomers Uncover a Mysterious Magnetic Web Above the Sun
articles.summary: A balloon-borne telescope above most of Earth's atmosphere revealed a tangled web of thin magnetic threads above the Sun's quiet regions.
